scope: Official full-pipeline rescore of the existing 200 N/R/T1/T2/T3 videos; no training or media generation
design_timing: Analysis specified before new official scores, after viewing the previous custom scores; this is a post hoc protocol investigation, not an independent confirmatory replication
unit: one independent speaker with one source recording; three fixed TTS seeds averaged within speaker
primary_endpoint: first printed official Sync-C track, following the historical official adapter; no score/length-based track selection

bootstrap.primary_family: Two main new30 Sync-C comparisons; 97.5% intervals for Bonferroni family coverage

protocol_comparison: Within-speaker differences of the official T-N/T-R contrasts minus previous common/native_full/equal_count_spread contrasts; paired bootstrap of the change, never subtract interval endpoints
reliability_supplement: EOS=true and duration_ratio in [0.5,2.0], using the previously frozen annotations; average qualifying T draws within speaker. Keep the original all-draw analysis as primary
coverage: Report all 200 planned cells and all 40 planned speakers. A missing/failed cell makes its five-role primary speaker tuple incomplete; show identities/reasons and descriptive complete-case results, mark primary coverage incomplete. No score/ASR/EOS/track-boundary exclusions and no imputation
support_audit: Retain every printed track and available official pickle/crop/frame metadata, with multi-track incidence and first-track support; do not choose the best scoring track
inference_limits: The full official chain jointly changes tracking, crop, audio processing and temporal support; no attribution to one component
Sync-C is an evaluator outcome, not human lip accuracy or quality
T-R does not isolate a pure text-LM effect because reference/decode contexts differ
A confidence interval crossing zero is not proof of equivalence or no effect
No effect-size threshold, power claim, sequential stopping or parameter search is introduced
Historical cohorts/backend/generation differences remain after this same-media protocol bridge
stop: Score all planned cells once with the fixed official settings, then analyze; stop on the declared engineering hard timeout/resource bound and report incomplete coverage, never stop according to score direction
